forbidden: This area is unavailable for your access.
unsaved: There are unsaved fields. Leave and discard them?
invalid: Check the fields and try again.
name: Description / name
cameraError: Could not open camera. Check and enter the details manually.
conflict: Another window changed the data. Refresh before saving.
belowCost: Discount would reduce the price below the entered cost.
scopeNote: This workspace saves preparation by company, store, user and device. It does not replace official records.
storageError: Could not read or save. Preserve your data and try again.
exceeds: Amount exceeds the open balance or is invalid.
matchInvalid: Amounts, type or an existing link prevent matching.
transition: This stage change is not allowed.
noAccess: Your profile cannot access this area.
sourceError: Could not query this source. Try refreshing.
_review: pt-BR source. en/es/fr/zh-CN require native speaker review before production.
posDescription: Prepare items and payments; use the connected checkout for cash sales.
closingDescription: Check retrieved sales, receipts, cash and deposit bags.
fiscalDescription: Prepare tax documents and requests for review before submission.
inventoryDescription: Count by product, location and lot; submit differences for review.
purchasesDescription: Review orders, book unloading and check partial deliveries.
lossesDescription: Assess cost, coverage, expiry and comparable periods before deciding.
productsDescription: Browse the catalog and preview price changes.
integrationNote: Official submission is unavailable here. Local review does not confirm a sale, payment, tax document, credit or stock movement.
activityNote: History for this local workspace; not a replacement for central auditing.
salePreparation: Prepare the sale here. Payment and stock are confirmed only by the connected workflow.
scanPlaceholder: Scan a barcode or search for a product
confirmCancel: Confirm cancellation? History will be preserved.
balanceError: Allocate the exact total across payments.
approvalRequired: An authorized supervisor must review this action.
checkRequired: Enter the driver and check every item before dispatch.
sourceRequired: Retrieve and select sales before saving the check.
unsupported: A payment method cannot yet be summarized here.
coverageNote: Retrieve all required pages. Only selected sales enter this check; one page is not assumed to be the whole shift.
keepConsulted: Add these sales to the local check
addMovement: Record opening, cash addition or withdrawal
cameraNote: The camera does not save photos. Review readings before entering receipt details.
ocrUnavailable: This browser has no built-in camera text recognition. Enter the fields below or paste text for review.
matchNote: Suggestions use amount, method and time proximity. A read receipt does not prove payment settlement.
noMatch: No match; check amount, method and time.
subsetNote: Summary of retrieved sales and local movements in this period. Use connected closing to close the official shift.
blindCount: Hide expected balance in the counter table
countBaseline: The baseline is entered for planning. Later movements must be checked before an official adjustment.
confirmPrices: Confirm prices in this draft only? The official catalog will not change.
labelNote: Preview with text code. Barcode printing and scale connectivity need device setup.
purchaseNote: Acceptance and confirmation here are local records. The supplier must confirm via an authorized channel for an official order.
policyNote: Returns, terms and credits follow the companies’ agreement; the system does not decide them.
receivingNote: Record only received quantities. Shortages stay pending; receiving does not automatically create payment or official stock entries.
collectionNote: Collection may accompany the next delivery. When ending supply, agree a route or deadline. Credit requires both parties’ confirmation.
slotConflict: This slot conflicts with another booking at the same dock.
taxNote: Codes are entered for review; classification and taxes require validation by the fiscal service and an authorized professional.
fiscalPreviewOnly: PREVIEW — NOT AN AUTHORIZED TAX DOCUMENT.
eventNote: Record the request and reason. This preparation sends no events to the tax authority.
fiscalInvalid: Check recipient, CPF/CNPJ, address, items, NCM, CFOP and CST/CSOSN.
lossNote: Low volume does not mean a loss. Compare equivalent periods and consider seasonality, cost and the product’s coverage.
previousComparable: Sales in a comparable period of equal length
confirmLoss: Authorize an action below entered cost and record the expected loss? Official prices and stock will not change.
renewalWarning: This product has a loss or slow-sales review. Check before reordering.
stockWarning: Recheck stock and movements before approval.
costUnavailable: Cost is not available for this access. Zero is not assumed as cost.
